title: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: 在中国农历中，立秋 (Start of Autumn)意味着夏天的结束和秋天的开始。立秋带来的首先是天气的变化，气温逐渐下降。人们看到树叶开始变黄飘落时，知道秋天已经来临，这就是所谓的"一叶知秋"。但此时酷热的天气并未完全结束，高温通常还会持续一段时间，被称为"秋老虎"。立秋对农民意义重大，这时各种秋季作物迅速生长、开始成熟，收获的季节即将到来。
reference: In the Chinese lunar calendar, the Start of Autumn marks the end of summer and the beginning of autumn. It first brings a change in the weather, as temperatures gradually drop. When people see the leaves begin to turn yellow and fall, they know that autumn has arrived; this is the so-called principle that "one falling leaf heralds the coming of autumn." However, the hot weather has not completely ended at this time; high temperatures usually continue for a while, a period known as the "Autumn Tiger." The Start of Autumn is of great significance to farmers, as various autumn crops grow rapidly and begin to ripen at this time, and the harvest season is approaching.
